mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust labor market conditions and strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and RSAFS increases fails to produce positive returns in >40% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts (HOUST) level above 850 thousand units signals strong residential demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 850 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods of PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 6.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates monetary easing and strong supply chain activity, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS decline and INDPRO rise fails to produce positive returns in >40% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 1.0% signals aggressive policy restraint that dampens economic growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
